items.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023
items.q: I did a tour with Boz Scaggs with Jeff Porcaro for the first month of the tour we were playing double drums with Jeff Porcaro

ctx.x: Yep. That was part of the — it sounds cliché, but part of the magic of the group was that Steve and I never discussed, you know I’ll play cross stick and you go to the bell and then I’ll play sixteenths on the hi-hat and you do bass drum. We never discussed a single element. We just sat down and played together. The fact that I grew up with three younger brothers and my dad playing drums in the house, often there were five sets of drums set up, made it feel pretty natural to play with another drummer. And I had…

And you could say the same thing about the two guitarists. How can a group with two guitar players and two drummers and a bassist and multi-keyboardist not be busy? And well the proof was in the records I guess.
